page.notes: The running head reads "INDEX X."; the X is a numeral and is given as the page number, "INDEX" as the running head. The large K at the start of Kedar is inferred from the printed "Edar" with a large K beside it. Doubtful: "pactū" (the word after "dicitur" may be read differently), and "iuncus" (printed form uncertain). Pencil ticks and marks in the margins and the right column are handwriting and were left out.
